# Cold Call Queue

Daily call lists live here as `YYYY-MM-DD.json`.

**Generated by:** `phone-qualifier` skill (Cowork command).
**Read by:** the cockpit on load (auto-detects today's file).

## Schema

```json
{
  "_date": "2026-05-12",
  "_generated_at": "2026-05-12T09:00:00Z",
  "_session_cap": 15,
  "prospects": [
    {
      "contact_id": "hubspot_contact_id",
      "business_name": "Acme Roofing",
      "first_name": "Mike",
      "last_name": "Roberts",
      "trade": "Roofer",
      "phone": "+1 555-123-4567",
      "city": "Dubuque",
      "state": "IA",
      "hubspot_url": "https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/...",
      "last_touched": "2026-05-01",
      "last_outcome": null,
      "notes_preview": "Brother handles marketing per gatekeeper note",
      "pipeline_stage": "First Touch Sent",
      "ai_hook": "Single-sentence AI-generated hook specific to this prospect — populated by phone-qualifier skill at queue build time. Example: 'Galena Plumbing has 14 reviews. Top plumber in the area has 180 — that's the gap.'",
      "mockup_url": "https://urbanbackstage.com/demo/<slug>/ — set ONLY if this prospect already has a free 'ghost page' homepage mockup built. Omit or null otherwise.",
      "pitch_mode": "mockup_reveal — set alongside mockup_url so the cockpit auto-engages Mockup Reveal mode for this record on load. Omit (or use \"standard\") for the normal cold-call flow."
    }
  ]
}
```

## Cool-down policy

Cockpit warns if `last_touched` is within 7 days unless `last_outcome` is `WARM`
with a pending callback. Override is per-call (one click "dial anyway").

## How phone-qualifier writes here

Cowork command at end of `phone-qualifier` skill output:

```
Step 7: Save the queue to GitHub
1. Format the prospects as JSON matching the schema above
2. Push to /sales-ops/cold-call/queue/{today_YYYY-MM-DD}.json on main
```

If no queue exists for today, cockpit falls back to manual-dial mode.


## ai_hook field

Each prospect in the queue can carry an `ai_hook` — a single sentence generated by Claude at queue build time, specific to that prospect's situation. The cold-call cockpit displays it on the prospect card before you dial.

**Generated by:** phone-qualifier skill (Claude API call per prospect using their HubSpot data + GBP/review data)
**Format:** One sentence, specific and factual. 'Heartland Roofing has 18 reviews. Top roofer in Dubuque has 210. Lead with that gap.'
**If absent:** cockpit shows notes_preview instead. Never blocks the dial.

## mockup_url / pitch_mode fields — Mockup Reveal mode

Some prospects already have a free "ghost page" homepage mockup built for them
(live at `https://urbanbackstage.com/demo/<slug>/`, not indexed publicly —
proof-of-work shown during the call, not a public site). The cockpit has a
**Mockup Reveal** HUD toggle (next to the AUTO/MANUAL opener-variant toggle)
that, when ON and the current prospect has a `mockup_url`, swaps the opener
and objection responses to the `scripts.mockup_reveal` section of
`scripts.json` — leading with "I already built you a free working homepage"
instead of the standard cold-open.

**When phone-qualifier builds a future queue and finds a prospect already has
a mockup built** (check the same way this batch was found — via
`demo/index.html` on urbanbackstage.com, or a future manifest of built
mockups), set on that prospect's queue record:

- `mockup_url`: the live demo URL, e.g. `"https://urbanbackstage.com/demo/il-example-co-ab12cd/"`
- `pitch_mode`: `"mockup_reveal"` — this tells the cockpit to auto-engage Mockup Reveal mode for this record when it loads (Ricky can still toggle it off manually per call)

Do **not** also write a generic `ai_hook` in this case — the mockup itself is
the hook. If `mockup_url` is absent, `pitch_mode` should be omitted (or set to
`"standard"`) and the prospect gets a normal `ai_hook` as usual.

If the Mockup Reveal toggle is ON but the loaded prospect has no `mockup_url`,
the cockpit falls back to the standard script automatically and shows a small
"No mockup for this contact — using standard script" note near the prospect
card. It never blocks the dial.
